arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.request_id,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.status cs from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status<>"confirmed"

select b.*, (select group_concat(charge_id||"|"||idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch, (select count(*) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) ob from bookings b where b.status<>"confirmed" or b.booking_id in ("bkg_6736cce9b28159079c49f266ab314ae8","bkg_b4e8baaa69825c71a1a99db526dc206e")
select * from charges where booking_id in (select booking_id from bookings where status="pending")

select o.event_id,o.status,o.attempts,o.payload,b.passenger_id,b.flight_id from outbox o left join bookings b on b.booking_id=o.booking_id where o.status="pending" and (o.payload not like "%"||b.booking_id||"%" or o.payload not like "%"||b.passenger_id||"%" or o.payload not like "%"||b.flight_id||"%" or b.booking_id is null)
select status,count(*) n from bookings group by status

select (select count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from checkins c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) nocheckin,(select count(*) from outbox where status="pending") pend,(select count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id and o.status="delivered")) nodeliv

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) nc,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) st,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) nh from bookings b where nc<>1 or nh<>(b.status="confirmed") or st<>"captured" order by 1
select event_id,status,attempts,payload from outbox where status<>"delivered" or event_id>"evt_00000395" order by event_id desc limit 12
